name: MATTHEW
canonical: Matthew the apostle, the former tax-collector of Capernaum once prosperous and now plainly dressed, a man of about forty with smoother well-kept light-olive skin softer than the fishermen's, a shrewd intelligent clean-lined face with alert watchful eyes, neatly groomed dark hair and a trimmed short dark beard, his once-fine garments now reduced to a simple muted blue-grey robe of good but worn cloth, a small reed pen and a folded writing-tablet tucked at his belt as a relic of his counting-table
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
